messages.subject: scan1snps error
parts:
Hi Karl,

We are trying to do association mapping following the instructions in the online tutorial 

ex:
`
scan1snps(probs, pmap, exprZ, kinship_loco, covar, 
                          query_func = query_variants, chr = 2, start = 80.392100, 
                       end = 84.392100, keep_all_snps = T)
`
and keep getting this error:

"
Error in if (is.null(is_x_chr) || !any(is_x_chr)) return(result) : 
  missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed
"

Tried running with different R versions on multiple sessions and updating qtl2. Any help is appreciated. 

Best,
Selcan

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: scan1snps error
parts:
It seems like the genotype probabilities have a missing value (NA) in the "is_x_chr" attribute. Is that right?

Look at it with:

   attr(probs, "is_x_chr")

Maybe try to strip it off completely:

   attr(probs, "is_x_chr") <- NULL

karl

messages.author: c852ede4bf9ac1ba
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl2-disc] Re: scan1snps error
parts:
Setting it to NULL worked! Thank you! 

NA wasn't the problem. This is what I get when I look at it:

`attr(probs, "is_x_chr")

[16] FALSE FALSE FALSE FALSE  TRUE
`
